extra.message: POST /api/auth/reset-password accepts a token but never validates it before replacing the password for the supplied email. An unauthenticated attacker can submit any nonempty token and reset any existing account, including the administrator account.

cwe: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password

extra.message: When SECRET_KEY is unset, JWT signing and verification use the public constant 'change-me-in-production-local-dev-only'. An attacker can sign a token with the sub of any active user and impersonate that user, including an administrator.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

extra.message: GET /ops/shell/ticket-probe-699 concatenates the host query parameter into os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host). A caller with a valid x-internal-token can inject shell metacharacters and execute arbitrary commands with the server's privileges.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command

extra.message: GET /ops/jinja/ticket-cast-679 concatenates the fragment query parameter into a Jinja2 template and renders it without a sandbox. A caller with a valid x-internal-token can supply template expressions that access Python objects and execute code on the server.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: POST /ops/dock/ticket-dropbin-slot-118 joins the unvalidated packet_ref query parameter to incoming_dir and writes the request body there. A caller with a valid x-internal-token can use ../ segments or an absolute path to create or overwrite files outside the export directory wherever the server has write permission.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: POST /ops/dock/ticket-shelf-726 uses the name query parameter as a filesystem path, creates its parent directories, and writes attacker-controlled bytes. A caller with a valid x-internal-token can supply traversal segments or an absolute path to create directories and overwrite files outside BASE_EXPORT_DIR.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: POST /ops/xml/ticket-fold-739 parses the request body with load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, and no_network=False. When lxml is available, a caller with a valid x-internal-token can supply external entity declarations that cause the parser to access local files or external resources. Returning only doc.tag does not prevent entity resolution during parsing.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The upload directory is mounted at /uploads without authentication or ticket authorization. Anyone who knows a stored filename can download its contents directly, bypassing the checks in /api/attachments/{attachment_id}/download. Seeded attachment filenames are enumerable screenshot_1000.png through screenshot_9999.png.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: PUT /api/tickets/{ticket_id} accepts customer users and checks only their organization before assigning every supplied TicketUpdate field. Customers can directly change staff-controlled status, assignee_id, and team_id on any ticket in their organization, bypassing the staff-only controls in the frontend and manipulating ticket routing and resolution.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: _authorize_ticket enforces organization scope for customers and team scope for support agents, but performs no check for team leads. A team lead can supply another team's ticket ID to read its details, internal notes, and attachments or modify it through callers of this helper, despite team-scoped ticket and escalation lists.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: GET /api/tickets applies team restrictions only when team_ids is nonempty. A support agent or team lead with no team memberships therefore receives tickets from every team, including descriptions and customer identities, instead of being restricted to unassigned tickets.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: PUT /api/escalations/{escalation_id} checks the team-lead role but never verifies that the escalation belongs to a managed team. Any team lead can change another team's escalation owner, reason resolution, or status by ID; resolving it also changes the associated ticket status to open.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: POST /api/export/tickets permits every staff role and queries tickets without team restrictions. A support agent can export other teams' ticket subjects, organizations, requester names, and assignees in CSV or JSON, including tickets that _authorize_ticket would deny.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: POST /api/export/sla permits every staff role and selects resolved or closed tickets across all teams. A support agent can export subjects, customer organizations, assignees, and SLA performance for tickets outside their authorized team scope.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: GET /api/search restricts tickets only for customers and applies no team filter for agents or team leads. Staff can search for another team's ticket and receive its full TicketOut, including description and customer identities. A query matching tickets but no KB articles also avoids the unrelated KB response-validation problem.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: GET /api/dashboard/stats accepts customer users but calculates all metrics over the entire Ticket table without organization filtering. Any customer can retrieve other organizations' aggregated ticket volumes, escalations, overdue counts, and resolution performance.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: GET /api/dashboard/sla accepts all staff but selects tickets without checking team membership. Agents can retrieve ticket IDs, subjects, assignee names, priorities, and SLA information from other teams even when direct ticket access is forbidden.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: GET /api/tickets/{ticket_id} includes every escalation's reason, resolution, and owner in customer responses. Unlike internal notes and private replies, these internal escalation fields have no customer visibility filter, exposing staff-only escalation content for the customer's organization.

cwe: CWE-201: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

extra.message: The SLA job sends each overdue ticket's number, subject, and link to every active team lead without checking managed teams. Running this job persists other teams' ticket information in notifications that recipients can retrieve through /api/notifications.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: Customer import creates every new account with the same password, 'changeme123'. Accounts are active by default and there is no mandatory password-change state. An attacker who knows an imported customer's email can log in with this public password and access that organization's tickets.

cwe: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password

extra.message: Ticket CSV export writes customer-controlled subject and profile-name values directly into cells without neutralizing spreadsheet formula prefixes. The SLA CSV export repeats this for subjects at lines 1102-1106. A customer can store a formula beginning with '=' that a spreadsheet application interprets when staff open the exported report; CSV quoting does not neutralize formulas.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: Attachment upload reads the entire uploaded file into memory and writes it permanently without a size limit or storage quota. Any customer authorized for a ticket can upload oversized files or repeatedly upload files to exhaust process memory or upload storage.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: The public login endpoint verifies passwords on every request without rate limiting, failed-attempt tracking, or account lockout. There is no application middleware providing these controls, allowing unrestricted online password guessing against known accounts.

cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

extra.message: Logout only deletes the browser cookie; it does not invalidate the JWT. Password reset likewise changes only the password hash. Because get_current_user checks only the token signature, expiration, and active user, a copied token remains usable after logout or password reset until expiration, eight hours by default.

cwe: CWE-613: Insufficient Session Expiration

extra.message: The access_token cookie is set without secure=True. Browsers can transmit this authentication token over HTTP to the application host, exposing the session to network interception when HTTP is reachable.

cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute

extra.message: GET /ops/fold/ticket-agent-file-120 omits Depends(_wrk_gate), and neither the router nor its registration supplies authentication. An unauthenticated caller can retrieve the operational snapshot, including ticket_count and ops_memo, without the internal token required by neighboring operations routes.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: GET /ops/after/ticket-lane-165 passes the lane query parameter directly to RedirectResponse without restricting its origin or requiring a local path. Requests carrying a valid x-internal-token can redirect clients to an attacker-controlled absolute or protocol-relative URL.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: POST /ops/wire/ticket-tally-230 logs the complete Authorization header and request body at WARNING level after internal-token authentication. Bearer credentials and any sensitive body contents are copied into logs, exposing them to log readers and downstream logging systems.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: GET /ops/blurb/ticket-tile-329 renders the card query parameter through '{{ card|safe }}' and returns it as HTML. Requests must carry a valid x-internal-token, but attacker-controlled card values are otherwise emitted as executable HTML, including script elements and event handlers, when the response is rendered in a browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

extra.message: GET /ops/nonce/ticket-roll-709 accepts an unrestricted length and performs that many random selections before joining the result. A caller with a valid x-internal-token can request an enormous length to exhaust memory and CPU. The synchronous loop runs inside an async handler and blocks the worker's event loop.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: The internal-token-protected partner request uses ssl._create_unverified_context(), disabling certificate and hostname verification. If the configured partner.invalid address resolves and is contacted, a network or DNS attacker can impersonate the HTTPS endpoint with an untrusted certificate.

cwe: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation

extra.message: Database seeding creates active administrator, staff, and customer accounts using the shared password 'demo123'. These are explicitly demo credentials, but any accessible installation retaining the seeded accounts permits login with publicly documented passwords.

cwe: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password

extra.message: When DATABASE_URL is unset, the application connects to PostgreSQL as postgres with the hardcoded password 'postgres'. An installation using these development defaults has a publicly known database credential available to anyone who can reach the database.

cwe: CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password
